parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
Two waves, with intensities I and 4I, superpose. The waves have the same frequency.
Determine, in terms of I, the maximum possible intensity of the resulting wave.
maximum intensity = I

parts.label: (c)
parts.question_text:
Coherent light of wavelength 550 nm is incident normally on a double slit of slit separation
0.35 mm. A series of bright and dark fringes forms on a screen placed a distance of 1.2 m
from the double slit, as shown in Fig. 4.1. The screen is parallel to the double slit.

distance = m

bright fringes.
